title: Purva Khanda - Genesis
summary: The origin of the universe and the duties of existence as revealed by Lord Vishnu to Garuda.
ai_summary: The Purva Khanda explores cosmological origins, righteous living (dharma), and the path of devotion. It emphasizes that a balanced life aligned with cosmic laws leads to spiritual evolution.

verses.sanskrit:
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ।
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamami |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ||
verses.translation: Having bowed down to Narayana, and to Nara, the foremost of men, and to goddess Saraswati, and to Vyasa, one should then utter 'Jaya' (victory).

layers.content: नारायण, नरोत्तम नर, देवी सरस्वती और व्यास को नमस्कार करके 'जय' का उच्चारण करना चाहिए।
नारायण, नरोत्तम नर, देवी सरस्वती आणि महर्षी व्यास यांना नमस्कार करून 'जय' (विजयाचा) उच्चार करावा.

layers.author: sankara
layers.content: The invocation establishes the supreme authority of the divine duo, Nara-Narayana, setting the foundation for the spiritual discourse that follows.

layers.author: dnyaneshwari
layers.content: ग्रंथाच्या सुरुवातीला ईश्वराचे स्मरण करणे हे मांगल्याचे लक्षण आहे. यातून भक्तीचा मार्ग प्रशस्त होतो.
